info.title: 校园场地预约系统接口契约
info.description: Design only; no business endpoints implemented. See api.md and requirements.md. Time zone Asia/Shanghai; IDs are decimal strings. All success responses use 200; only 200/400/401/403/404/500. Admin routes require ADMIN, personal booking routes and POST /bookings require STUDENT. Unknown request fields rejected. Proposed rules need review before freezing. Reviewed against requirements v0.1-rev1. Final target contract, not first-stage acceptance: concurrency protection is intentionally postponed until stage 2. Proposed calendar-day boundaries, daily counting semantics, manual bans and CHECKED_IN closure policy require review; see api.md section 8.

post.description: Always STUDENT; does not sign in. Duplicate name: 1002. Reject unknown fields.
Invalid credentials: 2001; disabled account: 2002. Suggested TTL=7200 seconds. No refresh token.

get.description: Any enabled authenticated role. Booking bans do not block this endpoint.
ENABLED venues only. Order by id ascending.

404.description: Missing resource or personal booking belongs to another user: 1004.

get.description: All statuses by default; order by startTime ascending. Availability is a snapshot. No schedule returns [].

404.description: Missing resource or personal booking belongs to another user: 1004.

post.description: STUDENT only. Atomically claim slot and create PENDING_PAYMENT, expireAt=creation+15min. Enforce enabled venue, availability, date today..today+13, future start, user interval conflict, daily limit 2 and booking ban. Not request-retry idempotent. Occupied slot: 3001. Server controls user, venue and amount. Daily counting is only a draft interpretation: count by slot date, include PENDING_PAYMENT/CONFIRMED/CHECKED_IN/NO_SHOW, exclude CANCELLED/EXPIRED. Requirements BR-04 do not settle these details. Review before implementation.

post.description: STUDENT owner only. No request body. PENDING_PAYMENT and now<expireAt -> CONFIRMED. CONFIRMED/CHECKED_IN return existing result; other states 3006. One effective payment per booking; serialize with expiry. Server amount, draft 0.00.

delete.description: ADMIN only. Reject any slot/booking references with 3006. No cascading history deletion. Success data=null; absent resource 404.

post.description: ADMIN only. Disabled venue:3006. Skip all overlapping intervals including closed slots. Repeats create no duplicates. Concurrent batches must not overlap. Unexpected errors roll back batch. Proposed date window is today through today+13 days inclusive, not merely an arbitrary 14-day span. Skip already-started candidates and count them in skippedCount.

404.description: Missing resource or personal booking belongs to another user: 1004.

post.description: ADMIN only. Atomically cancel PENDING_PAYMENT/CONFIRMED with ADMIN_CLOSED and close slot. No no-show penalty or real refund. Preserve payment history. BR-09 forbids cancelling CHECKED_IN while BR-14 does not state an exception: pending review, reject the entire close operation with 400/3006 if a CHECKED_IN booking exists, changing neither booking nor slot. Repeats keep original reason/time. Release tasks cannot reopen CLOSED slots.

ADMIN only. No passwords/hashes/tokens. Order createdAt and id descending.

put.description: ADMIN only, STUDENT target only; other role 403/2002. Idempotent same value. Existing bookings remain; enabling does not clear booking ban. Check account status on each authenticated request, including existing tokens. Pending decision: blocking all authenticated operations can prevent check-in/cancellation of existing bookings and cause no-show penalties; requirements must settle this policy.

get.description: ADMIN only. NO_SHOW booking projection; slot-date filters; booking createdAt and id descending. No direct create/delete.

put.summary: 设置或解除人工禁约（可选建议，待评审）
put.description: Optional F-13 elaboration, not an approved first-release requirement. ADMIN only; STUDENT target only, else 403/2002. A new non-null deadline must be in the future; null clears manual ban. Retrying the stored deadline succeeds even if time has since passed. Effective ban=max(automatic,manual); clearing manual never clears automatic punishment. Needs separate storage and audit; may be removed after review. BR-12 automatic bans remain required.

get.description: ADMIN only. Query existing slots for any date, including past dates and disabled venues; no student booking-window restriction. Optional status filter. Sort by startTime ascending. Missing venue:404/1004; no schedule:[]. Supports inspection and obtaining slotId for closing.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any slot date, including past dates.

VenueWrite.description: Full replacement. openTime < closeTime; no overnight opening.

VenueUsage.description: Current-state counts per venue and slot date. See api.md for definitions; rate rounded to 4 decimals.

ScheduleRequest.description: Draft: 60-minute slots. Proposed date window: today <= dateFrom <= dateTo <= today+13 days, inclusive. ISO weekdays. Times within venue opening hours and exactly divisible by slot duration. Skip already-started candidates and all interval overlaps, including closed slots; count each candidate once. Reject invalid input; unexpected errors roll back batch. Date-window and slot-duration decisions are not frozen.

BookingBanRequest.description: Optional proposal. New deadline must be future or null to clear manual ban. Retrying the stored value returns success even after expiry. Effective ban=max(automatic,manual). See api.md for pending decision.
